## Submission checklist

- [ ] I own or have permission to publish every included file; I understand the PR is public.
- [ ] Only my static export folder and its metadata entry are changed.
- [ ] The folder contains index.html and local assets, using relative paths.
- [ ] No secrets, company/private files, hidden files, dependencies, symlinks, or build configuration.
- [ ] At most 100 MiB total, 20 MiB per file, 300 files/directories.
- [ ] I tested the export under a subfolder, including required camera interactions.
- [ ] Metadata has no url or sample field; I did not edit workflow/gallery code.

Soo reviews and merges before GitHub Pages publishes. Passing checks alone is not approval.
